newsitem.title: USA: Dismissed worker opens fire at Indianapolis firm.
newsitem.headline: Dismissed worker opens fire at Indianapolis firm.

text.p: A man who had been dismissed from his job returned to the company on Friday with a gun and fired several shots, police said.

Initial reports indicated one person was wounded. The Marion County sheriff's office said dozens of workers fled the building housing the company, Hindostone Products, on the northwest side of Indianapolis.
The man, identified only as a Vietnamese male, was still inside the building but it was not clear if he was holding hostages, a spokeswoman for the sheriff's office said.
